source: Adversarial review round 2. Bodies are base64 so byte-level encoding reaches each host unchanged. RFC 8259 section 8.1: JSON text exchanged between systems MUST be UTF-8 and implementations MUST NOT add a BOM. Rust rejects both rows and Go rejects the BOM row; Go replaces invalid bytes with U+FFFD, and the TS host decodes through response.json(), which strips the BOM and replaces invalid bytes with U+FFFD.

bodies.name: UTF-8 BOM before a valid legacy body
